items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke announced that the 11 party volunteers detained by Delhi Police in Tuesday's (Oct-13) Jantar Mantar gate-entry incident have been released ('Spirits unbroken, waving the tricolour the moment they walked free'), calling their arrest illegal. Independently corroborated: Livemint reports (byline, Garvit Bhirani) that CJP legal head Ratna Singh credited advocate Abhisht Hela's legal team with 'securing the release of Ajinkya Shinde and 11 other volunteers detained by Delhi Police'. Ajinkya Shinde himself was released on a personal bond; Das and Ranka remain in 5-day judicial custody at Tihar.
items.title: RELEASE — 11 CJP volunteers freed from Oct-13 Jantar Mantar detention
